info.name: StageBet — local betting API
info.description: Import this JSON file directly into Postman Desktop. It includes health, betting, cash-out, and sandbox Stripe webhook manual tests. The webhook requests sign their payloads with stripeWebhookSecret and do not need JWT. For APPLIED and DUPLICATE, providerPaymentIntentId must already exist as a STRIPE_SANDBOX payment_intents.provider_reference. Do not use live Stripe secrets or card data.

request.description: Checks that the local Spring application is responding. No authentication is required.

exec: pm.test('Bet belongs to the requested player and round', function () {

header.description: Reuse this key for a retry; clear betId for a new bet.

request.description: Requires valid JWT authentication, a funded player wallet, and an OPEN round. Set tenantId, playerId, roundId, and accessToken first.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('Bet is cashed out', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('CASHED_OUT'); }); }

header.description: Reuse this key for a retry.

request.description: Requires valid JWT authentication and an accepted bet in a RUNNING round. Adjust expectedRoundSequence if the round has ticked.

exec: const payload = JSON.stringify({ id: eventId, type: 'payment_intent.succeeded', data: { object: { id: pm.collectionVariables.get('providerPaymentIntentId'), status: 'succeeded' } } });
if (!secret) { throw new Error('Set stripeWebhookSecret before sending this request'); }
const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(secret), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
const bytes = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, new TextEncoder().encode(`${timestamp}.${payload}`)));
pm.test('Webhook state was applied once', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Applies succeeded to the matching stored STRIPE_SANDBOX PaymentIntent. Send this before the replay request.

exec: if (!eventId) { throw new Error('Send Apply payment_intent.succeeded first'); }
const payload = JSON.stringify({ id: eventId, type: 'payment_intent.succeeded', data: { object: { id: pm.collectionVariables.get('providerPaymentIntentId'), status: 'succeeded' } } });
const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(pm.collectionVariables.get('stripeWebhookSecret')), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
const bytes = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, new TextEncoder().encode(`${timestamp}.${payload}`)));
pm.test('Webhook replay is a duplicate', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('DUPLICATE'); });

request.description: Reuses the event ID created by Apply and returns DUPLICATE without applying the payment state a second time.

exec: const payload = JSON.stringify({ id: pm.variables.replaceIn('evt_{{$guid}}'), type: 'payment_intent.succeeded', data: { object: { id: `pi_missing_${pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}')}`, status: 'succeeded' } } });
const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(pm.collectionVariables.get('stripeWebhookSecret')), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
const bytes = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, new TextEncoder().encode(`${timestamp}.${payload}`)));
pm.test('Unknown payment is retryable', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(500); });

request.description: Confirms a handler failure returns 500 and does not permanently claim the event, allowing a later retry.
